title: Member map
description: A principle's committed map, .principles/maps/ID.json: what the principle is, and each member that carries it. Fields this schema does not name are allowed, so an older version can read a map a newer one wrote.

format.description: The oldest map format that can read this map without losing what it says. Missing means 1. This tool writes it only when a member uses a field from a later format, and refuses a map whose format is newer than it knows.

activation.description: When the principle's work is in hand, as the agent declared it with change-activation: when files matching one of its globs are read or changed, when its work is invoked, or always. change-activation writes files only with when files; a hand-edited map is not yet checked for that.

key.description: What the member is known by across moves, which its audit record files its hash under. Absent, it is the member's id. move-member stores the old id here on a member's first move, and add-member gives a member a key of its own when its id is the key of a member that moved away.

check.description: The command that enforces this member, which an audit asks the agent to run and report. This tool never runs it.

pinned.description: For a member read from an installed plugin: the version the host had installed when it was mapped, and the SHA-256 of the member's text then. Only the hash says whether the text changed; the version is shown for information.
